design: C1 GN + FINAL force-equivalent motion/IMM + V1 online servo ID

implementation.stiffness: C1 repaired projection unchanged; a separate FINAL projection fit supplies exactly the existing k_good acceptance and motion measurement
implementation.drift: nominal rollout only: delta_f(h)=weight*k_good*(v*h+a*(0.5*Tc*h+0.5*h*h)); 1 ms table, full horizon, no legacy tv clipping; no extra tau*sd because servo explicit
implementation.recovery: C1 unchanged, IMM cleared and disabled while in C1 recovery/F<0.3; no additive external FF; C1 last-motion recovery rule retained
implementation.solver: Original source defaults: H=16, iters=1 (not the 3 claimed in prose); kept identical for original C1 and V4 per task preserve-settings instruction
implementation.variables: log D, KPF/(1e-4), uff_0/(1e-3), uff_slope/(1e-2); original warm start, ramp-then-hold, probes, residuals, bounds
implementation.ablation: V4-noFF retains C1 polynomial drift, adds V1 only, and shares the selected V4 ru to avoid confounding the motion ablation with a different control-rate penalty; no motion observer work
implementation.timing: Separate single-process pass, no physical real-time claim
implementation.information: only t, encoder y, filtered F, command; no Ft/My or contact/scene truth; existing gain and direct interfaces retained

protocol.baseline_note: C1 defaults and FINAL frozen by task; no baseline retuning

timing.protocol: Single process, 5 fixed diagnostic episodes, all ticks except first; includes estimator+IMM+ID+GN+recording; excludes JIT, plant, communication.

failure_analysis.selection: first and worst finite RMSE diagnostic scene per family after frozen evaluation
failure_analysis.scope: Post hoc descriptive diagnostics, not additional selection/tuning; no causal module-isolation claim.
failure_analysis.truth_boundary: True force/stiffness accessed only in scoring after the policy episode completes.
failure_analysis.forecast_metric: delta_f(h) compared to Ftrue(t+h)-Ftrue(t)-ktrue(t)*(y(t+h)-y(t)); frozen-local-tangent approximation, includes nonlinearity/stiffness changes.

execution_notes: Windows multiprocessing Pipe creation denied; persistent process workers use temporary file IPC.

At 39 saved trials an IPC PermissionError interrupted the next candidate; that same candidate was repeated after adding file-access retries. Exactly 61 distinct candidate configurations received completed objective scores; one interrupted attempt incurred extra simulation work, with no additional parameter selection opportunity.
All metric computation uses the existing common.task_metrics warmup=1 s and true-force scoring convention.
limitations: Prespecified historical baseline parameters frozen, not independently retuned 61 times on new seeds. V4 alone gets <=61 new two-parameter trials as requested.
Diagnostic and sweep seeds are historically used: no fresh-confirmation claim.
Divergent RMSE undefined; finite-only moments and complete-finite-pair bootstrap explicitly report exclusions; divergence separately counted.

Gain policy observes the prior logged row; direct policies consume the provisional current row as in their original implementations. Same sensor types, but existing timing/interface differences remain.
Nominal plant evaluation only; V1 mismatch validation is inherited, not newly established here.

conclusion.verdict: 未同时保住C1在S2的优势与Proposed在运动族的优势；不采纳当前V4拼接实例。
supported_findings: S2：V4均值0.159 N，较C1 0.089 N差0.069 N，配对95% CI [0.056,0.083]。V4较Proposed均值0.281 N更好，但中位数0.148 N差于Proposed 0.124 N；不能只报均值称兼得。
T3m、软推拉、硬推拉：V4均值分别较Proposed差0.894、0.074、3.647 N，配对区间均高于0。快速硬推拉差7.789 N，95% CI [6.031,9.795]；失控22/50、长失联45/50。
V4-noFF的S2为0.083/0.089 N，与C1基本一致；V4变差出现在接入运动预测后的闭环链条，而非仅增加V1辨识。
剂量扫描：V4在ratio=3时优于C1；ratio>=10时没有保住C1精度。运动扫描各档中位数均大幅差于Proposed；ramp=0.15时Proposed均值14.497 N反而高于V4的10.542 N，说明其尾部也严重，不能宣称逐档均值全胜。
failure_evidence: 恢复/启动阻塞（直接观测）：硬推拉8/50、快速推拉5/50从未启用运动预测；29/50和40/50超过半数拍处于恢复。场景113026在0.064 s进入恢复，991/999记录拍处于恢复，运动预测从未启用。失联关闭FF的规则与原C1恢复组合后，运动信息无法帮助这些场景。
长时域预测失真（直接观测）：T3m、硬推拉、快速推拉的名义力漂移预测绝对值最大6481、5032、3486 N，分别12/50、37/50、36/50场景出现>50 N预测漂移。它们是模型预测数值，不是真实接触峰值。
离线已实现轨迹诊断：场景111015的32/128 ms等效力漂移误差中位数2.465/9.595 N；114030为2.984/12.338 N。该指标采用冻结真实切线刚度，包含非线性/刚度变化，不能当成纯组织运动误差。
估计不是唯一解释：114030的有效量测增益kg/ktrue中位1.031，越过历史筛选区间的比例仅2.2%，但128 ms预测误差仍大；S2两个审计场景存在9.2%/26.1%的增益越界，现有接受准则也不保证该闭环分布下始终有效。
机制推断：FINAL原本只用于执行延迟附近的短前馈预测；将同一CA后验外推到完整128 ms、且把极端力漂移作为确定模型交给GN，会驱动不合适的参考整形，并与长恢复相互强化。当前证据未通过oracle预测或恢复替换独立量化每一环的因果份额。
next_step: 先改恢复与启动接口：使没有k_good的早期失联也能可靠重建接触，再在可信接触后重启量测；不能靠继续调运动权重解决从未启用的场景。
随后改预测：为长时域建立可信范围/不确定性衰减，避免把短时CA外推原样视为128 ms确定漂移。用固定增益/已知运动的分环核验区分增益失配与时域失配。
再检验优化如何使用不确定预测与恢复状态；本轮没有证据把增加GN迭代或换优化器列为第一优先项。保留估计增益偏差问题，但不将所有失败归给估计。
